message:
🚀 Flex GUI Pro — Version 7.5.0 Release
This major update brings a complete UI template expansion, a curated Gradients engine, redesigned CompSaver, restored Flex Browser integration, and critical undo group stability fixes.

♦️ CompSaver Workspace Overhaul & Custom Asset System
* Interface Redesign: Rebuilt CompSaver UI for faster access and cleaner layer/preset asset management.
* Custom Asset Tab: Added dedicated tab for managing and importing local asset files directly into host projects.

♦️ Flex Browser Addon (v2.0)
* Authentication System Compatibility: Re-integrated Flex Browser with complete compatibility for the updated Flex GUI Pro authentication layer.

♦️ UI Templates & Vector Engine Expansion (63 Total)
* 22 New Production-Ready UI Templates: Expanded library covering Social/Comments (Reels, TikTok, IG, WhatsApp, Discord, Slack), Creator/Broadcast (Subscribe Bars, Lower Thirds), and Product UI (Login, OTP, Cookie Banners, Polls).
* Bezier Path Vector Icons: Upgraded interface icons to native vector bezier paths for scalable 4K rendering.
* Template Studio Pipeline: Integrated complete studio pipeline support across all new templates including text slot content, colors, and entrance animation presets.

♦️ Motion Gradient System
* Curated Preset Ramps: Added 66 high-grade motion and SaaS color ramps (Stripe, Vercel, Supabase, Figma, Discord, Instagram).
* Color Ramp Accuracy: Standardized previews to strict 2-stop Ramp properties to match After Effects engine output.
* Interaction Controls: Enabled solid pick, 2-color Ramp apply, and 4-Color Gradient resampling shortcuts.

♦️ Engine & Undo Stack Fixes
* Undo Stack Corruption Fix: Resolved nested undo group mismatch issue where pressing Ctrl+Z / Cmd+Z after template generation threw errors and corrupted composition undo history. Grouped all build steps into a single clean undo entry.
